sections.title: Frontend Maturity
sections.summary: Desktop cockpit is in alpha with chat-first console, 4 layout modes, and 3 widget disclosure levels. WebSocket projection stream is live. Backend owns all policy transitions.

cards.title: Boot Sequence
cards.body_html: Provider onboarding, consent check, auth resolution, WebSocket bind, window launch. Dry-run and server-only modes supported.

cards.title: Intent Handling
cards.body_html: User intents (worktree_list, review, provider_status, etc.) dispatch through backend intents module. Results stream to frontend via projection.

cards.title: Layout Modes
cards.body_html: Operator, Review, System, and Technical layouts. Each mode renders a different widget grid configuration with adaptive sizing.

cards.title: Widget Disclosure
cards.body_html: Three disclosure levels: compact chips (summary), standard cards (detail), full-page expanded views. CSS transitions between levels.

items.definition: pywebview with pre-built HTML/CSS/JS frontend. No Node.js toolchain — static assets are compiled at build time.
WebSocket server (localhost-only, token-gated) pushes state projections as JSON. Frontend subscribes and renders reactively.
Frontend is a dumb renderer. Backend owns all policy transitions. Frontend displays projection fields as human labels; never infers or overrides policy.
Content-light projection stream. No raw file contents, secrets, or private code transmitted over WebSocket. SHA256 hashes for content-derived data.
Four layout modes with adaptive widget grids at three disclosure levels. CSS-only transitions between compact chips, standard cards, and full-page expanded views.
